subject: Re: Renewal package - SOC 2 reaffirmation and capacity amendment request
messages:
From: Elena Torres <security@acme-payments.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sam Bennett <procurement@acme-payments.com>, Rajesh Shah <auditor@trustaudit.io>
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: SOC 2 reaffirmation needed for upcoming renewal + capacity increase

Hi Michael / Marissa,

As we work through our renewal for Acme Payments (current term ends 2027-05-23), legal and our security team flagged that we need a fresh reaffirmation of SOC 2 controls tied to the renewal and the requested capacity increase (from 4 dedicated GPUs to 8). Specifically, they need:

- Updated SOC 2 Type II report or a letter from your auditor confirming no significant control changes since last report.
- Evidence around retention and audit logging for the Dedicated deployment (log retention windows, access logs, export capability).
- Confirmation of whether audit log exports can be scoped to our account and time range (we will require exports for a rolling 24-month period).

We also attached our proposed SOW with the capacity amendment inline (Acme_Renewal_SOW_v3.pdf).

Can you confirm timeline? Procurement wants the documents and any redlines completed by 2027-05-18 to keep invoicing on schedule.

Thanks,
Elena Torres
Head of Security, Acme Payments
security@acme-payments.com

Attachment: Acme_Renewal_SOW_v3.pdf (application/pdf, 128KB)

From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Torres <security@acme-payments.com>, Sam Bennett <procurement@acme-payments.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Rajesh Shah <auditor@trustaudit.io>
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 reaffirmation needed for upcoming renewal + capacity increase

Elena — thanks for the clear ask and the SOW. We can get this prioritized. Quick summary of next steps from our side: 

1) SOC 2: We will request a reaffirmation letter from our auditor (TrustAudit) and provide an interim control summary by 2027-05-11. If TrustAudit can issue a formal letter we will share immediately.

2) Audit logs / retention: Vivek will pull the retention matrix and a sample export showing account-scoped logs going back 24 months (where available).

3) Capacity amendment: We’ll review the SOW redlines in parallel; Marissa will propose any commercial adjustments tied to the capacity increase.

Target: deliver the SOC 2 control summary + retention evidence by 2027-05-11 so procurement has time to review before the 5/18 deadline. If anything slips we will flag immediately.

I’ve attached our internal plan doc (SOC2-2027-reaffirmation-plan.docx) and a retention CSV Vivek prepared.

Best,
Michael Grant
Head of Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
michael.grant@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0132

Attachments: SOC2-2027-reaffirmation-plan.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document, 26KB); retention-matrix.csv (text/csv, 4KB)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.ai>, Elena Torres <security@acme-payments.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Rajesh Shah <auditor@trustaudit.io>
Date: Wed, 5 May 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 reaffirmation needed for upcoming renewal + capacity increase

Hi all — looping in the technical evidence thread. A few specifics that should address Acme’s asks: 

- Audit log exports: we can provide account-scoped exports in JSONL with event types (auth, admin-change, model-invoke, billing). Sample attached: audit-log-extract-sample.jsonl 
- Retention: Hosted default = 13 months; Dedicated customers can opt-in to extended retention (24 months) as part of a configuration flag — which I confirm is available for Acme’s Dedicated pool. We will provide the configuration record and a one-time backfill for up to 24 months where data exists.
- Access logs: we can produce signed timestamps / sequence numbers to support tamper-evidence for the exported slice.

Please note: there are rare entries prior to 2025 that are archived on cold-storage and will need an additional 48-72 hour retrieval window; we’ll flag those explicitly if requested.

Attaching the sample extract. If the auditor needs specific query parameters (user ids, timeframe), share the spec and we’ll run it.

-Vivek
Director, Platform Security
Redwood Inference

Attachment: audit-log-extract-sample.jsonl (application/x-ndjson, 45KB)

From: Rajesh Shah <auditor@trustaudit.io>

Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 6 May 2027 10:41:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 reaffirmation needed for upcoming renewal + capacity increase

Hi team,

I reviewed the initial plan and the sample extract. A few follow-ups from the audit side: 

- For a reaffirmation letter we require a short control-change cert from Redwood’s security lead stating there have been no material changes to scope or control design since the last Type II period. Vivek — can you provide that statement (250-400 words) by EOD 2027-05-10?

- The JSONL export looks fine; please include the query parameters you used (time range, event_types, account_id) and a checksum (sha256) for the export file. That allows us to validate integrity.

- If Acme needs formal attestation language added into the contract amendment, I can draft recommended wording and provide it as a DocuSign-ready attachment.

I’ll prepare a one-page draft reaffirmation letter template and share comments by 2027-05-09.

Regards,
Rajesh Shah
Lead Auditor, TrustAudit
auditor@trustaudit.io

Date: Fri, 7 May 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 reaffirmation needed for upcoming renewal + capacity increase

Elena / Sam —

Thanks everyone for quick turnarounds. Concrete next steps and owners: 

- Vivek: provide the control-change statement + the exact export query params and sha256 checksum by 2027-05-10.
- Rajesh: draft reaffirmation letter template and optional contract attestation language by 2027-05-09.
- Marissa: redlines to the SOW and any pricing delta for 8 GPUs vs 4 GPUs by 2027-05-11.
- Neha: I’ve asked CS to prepare a one-time backfill run plan; Neha will confirm a schedule (48–72 hours if cold retrieval is needed).

Proposed mutual action plan (MAP):
- 2027-05-09: auditor letter draft + control-change statement delivered
- 2027-05-11: SOC summary + retention CSV + SOW redlines
- 2027-05-18: procurement sign-off & DocuSign amendment executed

If that timeline works I’ll lock the MAP in the shared drive and route the DocuSign amendment once we have Rajesh’s language.

Elena — please confirm acceptance of the MAP or flag any blockers.

Regards,
Michael

P.S. Neha just confirmed offline that we can accommodate the 24-month retention toggle for Acme in the Dedicated pool without infra changes; she’ll post the backfill window later today.

--
Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
(added in-thread)
